expansionRules.description: Future model/series pages must attach to the closest product or brand owner, never directly to Homepage.
Condition/problem pages must attach to their product owner (e.g. Notebook condition → Notebook hub).
District/local pages attach to the Local hub; no district may parent unrelated districts.
iPhone/iPad/MacBook/iMac/Mac mini/Apple Watch belong to Apple ownership, not Mobile ownership.
Android brand pages roll up through the Android hub, then Mobile.
New indexable expansion requires distinct intent + sufficient unique value + at least two planned internal discovery paths.
Do not merge, redirect, canonicalize across, or noindex a competing live URL without query→page evidence.
